decisions: D1 retire, never delete: POST /api/v1/areas/{areaId}/retire and /restore (expectedRevision + reason) lock the area row, pin its revision, set or clear archived_at, archive_reason and the new archived_by, and write one map_area_events row (retired | restored, actor, reason, time). D2 same bytes in a new case: caseScopedDestination gives a file:<sha256> namespace the suffix :case:<caseId> when no live area of this case holds it (by seed key or feature links), on both the recipe path (authorTx) and the large path (largeDestination). The new case gets its own source row and area; the existing area is untouched. Within one case the refusal stays; a retired area never refuses.
gaps: D2 'reuse the stored object (no second copy)' is not delivered: sources.object_key is UNIQUE (database/sql/01-core) and every reader opens row.object_key, so a second source row sharing one object needs a non-additive schema change or a blob indirection. A new case's retain still stores its own copy. Lead decision needed.
